palette.primary_role: 主色 — Deep navy or dark charcoal used for text, headers, and primary CTAs. Home brands gravitate toward sophisticated darks rather than pure black.
palette.accent_role: 强调色 — sparingly used: Casper uses red for sale badges, Floyd uses electric blue for announcement bar, Burrow uses coral/warm orange for accents.
palette.surface_role: 背景色 — warm whites, cream, light beige, soft gray predominate. Floyd and Parachute lean warm (cream/beige). Casper uses clean white with cool blue-gray sections.
palette.neutral_role: 文字颜色 — dark navy or charcoal for body text, medium gray for secondary/metadata text.
palette.border_role: 边框 — minimal. Most brands use spacing/whitespace instead of borders. When used, borders are very light (rgba with 0.12 alpha or light gray).

heading_fonts: Suisse Intl (Burrow, Parachute — warm geometric sans, weights Regular/Medium)
Floyd Gothic (Floyd — custom geometric sans, very light weight 200-300)
Petrona (Parachute — Google Fonts serif, used for editorial headings)
typography.heading_letter_spacing: -0.02em to -0.05em for large headings (Floyd uses -3.2px on 64px H1)

content_max_width.note: Most brands use fluid or wide containers. Floyd uses 100% width with inner padding.

card_padding.note: Product cards often have minimal or no padding — the image fills the card, text sits below.

hero_padding.note: Hero sections often use minimal padding (0-30px) as the background image fills the space.

border_radius.cards: 0px (universally — home brands favor sharp corners on cards, relying on image content for visual interest)

elevation.shadows: None or extremely subtle. All 5 brands use box-shadow: none on product cards. Home/decor favors flat, clean design over material elevation.

typical_order: announcement_bar (promo: 'Free Shipping' / 'Summer Sale — Save up to 60%' / 'Memorial Day Sale')
header (logo left or center, nav: Shop / Categories / Collections / About / Stories, icons: search + account + cart, sticky on scroll)
hero (full-bleed lifestyle photo, headline overlaid or beside image, 1-2 CTAs)
category_browse (by room or product type: Bedroom / Living / Dining / Office — large photo tiles with overlay text)
featured_collections / best_sellers (product grid: 2-4 columns, photo-forward, name + price below)
product_spotlight (single product deep-dive, multiple photos, specs, color/material options)
brand_story / craftsmanship (materials, sustainability, 'designed in ___', about the makers)
benefits_bar (free shipping, easy returns, warranty, trial period — icon + short text per benefit)
reviews / press_quotes (Architectural Digest, Dwell, New York Times, etc. — carousel format)
room_inspiration / lookbook (Instagram-style grid, UGC photos, lifestyle imagery, 'shop the look')
newsletter_signup (simple email input, often on brand-color background)
footer (shop by category, about, support, social links, copyright)
hero_variants: single_full_bleed_room_photo (most common — hero is one large lifestyle image with heading + CTA overlaid)
split_layout (left product photo, right headline/CTA — seen on product category pages)
video_background (Casper, Burrow, Floyd all have video — lifestyle video loop in hero area)
carousel_slider (Parachute uses splide carousel in hero area with multiple lifestyle slides)
card_variants: product_card (full-bleed product photo in room context, product name below, price, color swatch dots, no card shadow, no border — image IS the card)
category_card (large photo tile with room/category name overlaid in white text, clickable to collection)
inspiration_card (lifestyle photo, no visible text or minimal overlay, 'shop the look' on hover, Instagram-aesthetic)

observed_section_sizes.Casper: tight spacing, Shopify sections, announcement bar (navy bg) + shop-by-category carousel + product cards + benefits bar + footer
observed_section_sizes.Article: SPA React app, minimal DOM structure, image-heavy, category-forward layout
observed_section_sizes.Parachute: Shopify with custom sections, mega-menu nav, carousel hero, product bundles, editorial content blocks
observed_section_sizes.Burrow: React SPA (Oxygen/Headless), modular product configurator, video backgrounds, swiper carousels for materials/colors
observed_section_sizes.Floyd: Shopify custom theme, announcement bar (bright blue), 'Systems for Living' product ecosystem, membership program prominent, cookie consent

tone_profile.headline_style: Aspirational yet approachable. Emphasize quality materials, comfort, and design intent. Typical patterns: 'The Best [Product] for Better [Activity]' (Casper), 'Systems for Living' (Floyd), 'Home happens here' (Parachute). Short, evocative, emotion-forward.
tone_profile.cta_style: Low-pressure, exploratory. Common CTAs: 'Shop the Collection', 'Explore', 'Shop Now', 'See All', 'Discover', 'Design Your Space'. Avoid aggressive urgency — home purchases are considered decisions.
trust_signals: 100-night trial / risk-free trial (Casper pattern — adopted by mattress/furniture DTC brands)
Press quotes (Architectural Digest, Dwell, NYT, Wirecutter, Apartment Therapy)
Financing options (Shop Pay installments, Affirm, Klarna)
anti_patterns: Avoid cluttered product grids with heavy borders/shadows — home brands let imagery breathe
Avoid harsh/neon colors — palette stays in warm neutrals, earth tones, sophisticated darks
Avoid stock-looking isolated product photos — in-context lifestyle photography is mandatory
Avoid aggressive discount language — sales are announced subtly (announcement bar, not screaming hero CTAs)
Avoid pure black (#000) — all brands use near-black (navy or dark charcoal) for text
Avoid heavy box shadows on cards — flat/clean is the standard
Avoid small, cramped typography — generous line-height (1.5-1.8x) and breathing room

color_mood.name: warm_neutral_minimal
color_mood.description: Cream/beige backgrounds, dark charcoal text, warm wood tones in imagery. Parachute and Floyd exemplify this.

color_mood.name: clean_cool_sophisticated
color_mood.description: White backgrounds, navy text, cool blue-gray accent sections. Casper exemplifies this.

color_mood.name: dark_moody_sophisticated
color_mood.description: Dark charcoal backgrounds, white/cream text, dramatic photography. Burrow leans this direction with dark nav and rich material photography.

typography_mood.name: elegant_serif_headings
typography_mood.description: Serif or serif-adjacent headings (NewKansas at Casper, Petrona at Parachute) paired with clean sans-serif body. Conveys heritage, craftsmanship, luxury.

typography_mood.name: warm_geometric_sans
typography_mood.description: Geometric sans-serif throughout (Suisse Intl, Floyd Gothic). Conveys modern, approachable, design-forward. Most common among the 5 brands.

layout_density.name: spacious_lifestyle_forward
layout_density.description: Large hero images, generous whitespace, fewer products on screen. Floyd and Parachute exemplify — the photography is the primary design element.

layout_density.name: product_grid_focused
layout_density.description: Tighter product grids (3-4 columns), more products visible above the fold. Casper and Article lean this way — still image-heavy but more SKU-focused.

platforms.Casper: Shopify (custom theme, Shopify CDN fonts, Shopify sections)
platforms.Article: Custom React SPA (Next.js likely, no Shopify)
platforms.Parachute: Shopify (custom theme with Rebuy, Yotpo, Splide carousel)
platforms.Burrow: Shopify Hydrogen/Oxygen (React SPA, headless Shopify, custom CSS modules)
platforms.Floyd: Shopify (custom theme, Klaviyo, OneTrust cookie consent)
